newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll sees '96 profit close to 1995.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll sees '96 profit close to 1995.

text.p: Swiss technology group Von Roll Holding AG said it expected restructuring costs to remain high this year, but net profit for the full year should still come close to 1995's 27 million Swiss francs.
Von Roll said in a statement that the divestements undertaken this year would initially significantly reduce its turnover, but improve the value of its product portfolio.
The sale of its steel activities significantly reduce Von Roll's debt, strengthens its financial ability and should lead to a free cash flow, already this year.
However, it will also increase the depreciation, but this will be done over equity and reserves without reducing the quality of the balance sheet, it said.
